text:
alex: Heads-up — deploy-bot suggested skipping a patch bump for a config-only change in telemetry ingestion. Is skipping ok for stable channel? @tanya

tanya: quick q — is this truly docs/config only? any schema or runtime flag changes?

kevin: saw the diff, just a prometheus scrape tweak + ci matrix. looks config-only to me.

deploy-bot: [automated] change-diff: config/** telemetry/**; suggested-action: SKIP_PATCH_BUMP (reason: non-functional/config-only) :robot_face:

sam: I'd be 👍 to skip if release notes don't need a line. but our release note generator skips config-only by default, right?

release-bot: release-gen: detected 1 change (config). notes: NONE. skip-heuristic: enabled. To override use `/release force-bump patch` or add comment `@release-bot bump:patch`

alex: Okay — main concern is pinning behavior. If we skip bump, do we still tag buildmeta so customers on dedicated see stable artifacts?

kevin: we currently preserve buildmeta when bump skipped, so artifact is still unique: eg `v1.12.3+20240912` vs `v1.12.3`. but that can confuse the deploy pipeline pin heuristics.

tanya: Suggestion: use a deterministic pin rule — if change touches runtime/api -> require explicit patch bump; config-only -> allow skip but add `skip:config` note in the changelog metadata so infra tooling can differentiate.

sam: agree. otherwise ops teams hitting `pin:latest` might autoswap to a buildmeta and cause subtle drift.

kevin: minimal config snippet proposal:```yaml
release:
  bump_on:
    - api/
    - runtime/
  skip_on:
    - docs/
    - configs/
  annotate_skipped: true
```

alex: nice. question on rollback tie-breaker: if a skipped-bump release causes an incident and we need to rollback, do we prefer roll forward (patch bump + hotfix) or revert to previous tag?

tanya: Roll-forward preferred for user-facing bugs; revert for config toggles. For skipped bumps we likely want a revert if the config flip is root cause. but we should set a 30m rollback SLA window in deploy playbook.

kevin: +1. Add to playbook: "if deploybot skipped bump and incident > severity 2 within 30m -> revert config change and mark for patch release"

deploy-bot: action-log: suggested skip applied. note: operator override available with `@deploy-bot apply-bump patch`

alex: I'll add the config snippet to infra repo and update playbook. filing tiny RFC for the pin rule so PMs know behavior. thanks all :raised_hands:

sam: quick follow-up — can release-bot add an annotation on release page when skip is used? helps audits.

release-bot: noted. will add `skipped_bump: true` metadata and link to changelist.

kevin: cool. sounds like consensus. I'll draft the PR for the release config and playbook change this afternoon.

alex: perfect. closing thread unless objections in 2 hours.
